title: Widget rotation button can be fully obstructed by tooltip, making it inaccessible
line: On rotated desktop widgets, the edit-mode handle tooltips no longer cover their buttons, so the rotate button can always be grabbed.
explanation: Tooltips are popups that are never rotated: only their top-left point is mapped through the widget's rotation. On a widget rotated about 15 degrees counter-clockwise, the rotate button's tooltip therefore lands exactly on the button, and since it appears instantly and takes the mouse press, the widget can no longer be rotated. The handle buttons now place their tooltip above the button's on-screen bounds, which is identical to the old position for unrotated widgets.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: Keep handle tooltips off the buttons of rotated widgets

On a rotated widget, only the tooltip's position was mapped through the
rotation, so it could land right on its button, swallow every press and
make the rotate button unusable. Place it above the button's bounds.

BUG: 523678
